Six character runtime models — separate rights notice

The six lossless .glb.gz runtime archives under dist/assets/drivers/ are supplied for this
non-commercial AI Friends Kart demo. They are distinct from the AGPL-3.0-only
game code and original kart, props, track and UI.

The project owner identifies these character outputs as originating from
Tripo Free and subject to non-commercial restrictions. The exact applicable
redistribution terms have not been independently established here. Inclusion
in this demo must not be read as a claim that all redistribution rights have
been verified or cleared. This notice does not grant a new license, a Creative
Commons license, commercial rights, sublicensing rights, or any other rights
beyond those actually held under the applicable original terms.

Do not treat these characters as AGPL assets. Code availability does not
relicense model geometry, textures, character designs or associated rights.
This demo has no advertisements, payment flow or commercial model sale.
Before reusing, redistributing or monetizing the models, establish the rights
and obtain any permission required by their applicable terms. The project
owner's permission to publish this demo is not a general rights grant.

The public runtime manifest is docs/runtime-models.json. It lists exactly six
final model paths, byte sizes and SHA-256 checksums. Only losslessly compressed final runtime GLBs are
included; no new character Blender projects, raw high-poly originals, separate
textures, work files or private source references are distributed. Non-runtime
private metadata has been removed without changing embedded model payloads.

The corresponding-source ZIP intentionally does not duplicate the large
character GLBs. They are separately served at assets/drivers/<id>-driver.glb.gz
beside the demo. A full repository clone includes them. Rebuilding only the
code/source ZIP works without them; for the six-character demo, copy those six
files into dist/assets/drivers/ or run the documented manifest-verified fetch
script. The original kart/prop Blender source files were already public and
remain included for their AGPL corresponding-source completeness.
